artist: Ripple Effect Band On The Importance Of Storytelling
title: Breaking And Entering: Ripple Effect Band On The Importance Of Storytelling
summary: Ripple Effect Band members Jodie Kell and Rachel Thomas stopped by the studio to talk with Lauren and Simon about songwriting in the now-endangered language of their people, their home on Arnhem Land and how they came to be the critically acclaimed all woman rock band.
